name: GitHub, Issue Queue
description: Open issues assigned to you plus issues you opened, or unassigned and assigned issues across an organization. Each row carries an issue-age chip (muted → ochre → terracotta → plum as the issue ages), compact labels, and a comment-bubble chip showing discussion activity. Sections are sorted oldest-first so the stalest issue floats to the top.
